requirements.requirement: The system must normalize user condition input by converting all text to lowercase before processing.
The system must tokenize user condition input into discrete terms using whitespace and punctuation delimiters.
The system must map known condition synonyms to a canonical normalized term using a predefined synonym dictionary.
The system must normalize trial condition strings using the same normalization pipeline applied to user input.
The system must identify an exact match when a normalized user condition term exactly equals a normalized trial condition term.
The system must assign the highest relevance score when an exact match is detected.
The system must detect partial matches when user condition tokens overlap with any subset of trial condition tokens.
The system must assign a relevance score for partial matches that is strictly lower than the score for exact matches.
The system must invoke a semantic similarity method when neither exact nor partial matches are found.
The system must compute a semantic similarity score between normalized user condition input and trial conditions using an embedding or equivalent method.
The system must ensure the final relevance score is normalized to a numeric value between 0 and 1 inclusive.
The system must select the highest scoring match across all trial conditions as the final relevance score.
The system must return the match_type value consistent with the scoring path (exact, partial, or semantic).
The system must include matched_terms in the output when an exact or partial match is identified.
The system must return a relevance score of 0 when no match is found and semantic similarity falls below a defined threshold.
The system must handle multiple user condition inputs by evaluating each condition independently and selecting the maximum relevance score.
The system must ignore null or empty user condition inputs and return a relevance score of 0 with match_type set to none.
The system must handle missing or empty trial condition lists by returning a relevance score of 0 without error.
The system must ensure deterministic outputs for identical inputs across repeated executions.
The system must complete condition normalization and scoring within a bounded execution time suitable for synchronous API use.
